# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore release notes — captured 2026-08-23
# Source used: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/release-notes.html
# (sources.json still points at doc-history.html, which renders title/nav only — recurring since
#  2026-05-18 and still unfixed)

## August 2026 — now TWELVE entries (was eleven on 2026-08-21). ONE is new.

- **NEW 2026-08-23: Memory — store and extract non-conversational JSON payloads.**
  `CreateEvent` accepts a **`json` payload type**: non-conversational, JSON-formatted data —
  "behavioral events, activity logs, and system events" — **up to 100 KB for EACH payload**.
  THE EXTRACTION ASYMMETRY IS THE DETECTION RULE (from /short-term-create-event.html):
    "Conversational and JSON payloads are extracted into long-term memory.
     Blob payloads are stored in short-term memory only and are not extracted."
  JSON payloads run through the **semantic, user preference, summarization and episodic** strategies.
  => the memory WRITE PATH NO LONGER REQUIRES A CONVERSATION. Any system that can emit a CreateEvent
     writes durable, LLM-extracted agent memory. Payload TYPE (not size/source) decides whether
     stored data can influence future sessions.        [reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/AIDR]
  /short-term-create-event.html , API_CreateEvent.html

## Carried forward from the 2026-08-21 capture (unchanged)
- Payments — x402 `upto` scheme + Machine Payments Protocol (MPP). `upto` pays a METERED AMOUNT UP TO
  A CEILING, settles via the **Permit2 contract**. MPP: merchant returns `WWW-Authenticate: Payment`
  in a 402; caller forwards the challenge VERBATIM to `ProcessPayment` with `paymentType=MPP`;
  AgentCore parses it, checks the SESSION BUDGET, SIGNS WITH THE WALLET, returns a ready-to-send
  credential replayed in an `Authorization` header. Methods: evm, tempo, solana.
                                                       [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AIRT]
- Payments — Quick create for Coinbase connectors: AgentCore PROVISIONS YOUR COINBASE CDP CREDENTIALS
  FOR YOU via browser authorization. No API keys touched by a human. Coinbase only; Stripe (Privy)
  still customer-supplied, so connector type predicts credential provenance.
                                                       [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
- Evaluations — Skill evaluators: `Builtin.SkillSelectionAccuracy` (did the loaded skill fit, GIVEN
  THE CATALOG) and `Builtin.SkillInstructionFollowing` (five-point). One result PER SKILL INVOCATION,
  anchored to the tool-call span that loaded the skill. Custom TOOL_CALL evaluators read
  `invoked_skill`, `skill_content`, `available_skills`, `user_message`.
                                                       [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
- Evaluations — Third-party evaluators from **DeepEval** and **AutoEval**. MANAGED (AWS runs it on a
  model IT operates) or DERIVED (your model + inference). Both discoverable via `ListEvaluators`
  ALONGSIDE built-in and custom — provenance is NOT distinguished on the inventory surface.
                                                       [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
- Payments — Coinbase wallet usage billed through AWS Marketplace. Mandatory subscription to the
  "Coinbase Wallets for AgentCore Payments" listing, enforced at connector creation and wallet ops.
                                                       [BILLING PLUMBING — held below the bar]
- Memory, policy, harness in AWS GovCloud (US-West) `us-gov-west-1`.        [region expansion, held]
- Runtime: Instances compute type with capacity providers.                  [reported 2026-08-07]
- AWS Agent Registry under the `agent-registry` namespace — private governed catalog of agents,
  tools, skills, MCP servers and custom resources; console + control/data-plane APIs + the registry's
  own MCP endpoint; `ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords`, `BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord`; record
  tagging; required `recordType`; Record directory console page; nine Regions. [reported 2026-08-07]
- Gateway: Configurable rate limits — dimensional scoping, JWT claims, `iam.sourceIdentity`,
  wildcard catch-all, most-specific-match-wins; RPS/RPM, TPM, Connections; `rate=0` = explicit block;
  ~30s propagation; FAILS OPEN. Six ops + BatchPutRateLimitEntries.         [reported 2026-08-07]
- Runtime: simplified/increased API rate quotas.                      [quota change, held 08-14]
- Gateway: Web Search Tool in eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1.          [region expansion, held 08-14]

## July 2026 and earlier — unchanged
Web Search connector v1.2.0; Identity Private Key JWT client auth; Harness InvokeHarness streams MCP
tool result metadata; Runtime unified span destination; Evaluations/Optimizations PrivateLink;
Evaluations framework support; ActiveSessionCount metric. Earlier: Web Search GA, Policy + Bedrock
Guardrails, Harness GA, Recommendations GA, Batch Evaluations GA, A/B Testing GA, Managed Knowledge
Base GA, Failure Insights preview, Gateway Runtime/HTTP-passthrough/inference targets, Runtime
Interactive Shells, Step Functions, CLI/CDK payments support.

## Data-plane Actions API — RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-23, NO CHANGE
Operation list is **operation-for-operation identical** to the 2026-08-07 capture. No net-new
operations. (`SearchRegistryRecords` remains the only registry op on the AgentCore data-plane page;
`ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords` / `BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord` live on the separate AWS
Agent Registry API surface.) See amazon-bedrock-agentcore_api.txt.

Updated: 2026-08-23 — one new August entry (Memory json payload type), reported.
